description: Defines the GpuMojoMediaClient class and related functions for GPU media handling in Chromium, including platform-specific video decoder creation, configuration support, and media client interface implementation.

classes.name: GpuMojoMediaClient
classes.description: A media client implementation that manages GPU-based media decoding, configuration, and platform-specific decoder creation.

classes.name: VideoDecoderTraits
classes.description: Encapsulates parameters for platform-specific video decoder creation.

methods.name: CreatePlatformVideoDecoder
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific VideoDecoder instance based on provided traits.

methods.name: NotifyPlatformDecoderSupport
methods.description: Ensures platform video decoder configurations are known and calls a callback with the decoder remote.

methods.name: GetPlatformSupportedVideoDecoderConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves supported video decoder configurations for the platform.

methods.name: CreatePlatformCdmFactory
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific Content Decryption Module factory.

methods.name: GetPlatformDecoderImplementationType
methods.description: Returns the platform-specific decoder implementation type.
